ipaddr.description: IP address or hostname of the remote IPMI interface (e.g., '192.168.1.100' or 'ipmi-node1.example.com')

login.description: Username for IPMI authentication (must have operator or admin privileges)

cipher.description: IPMI cipher suite ID (0–5 or 6 for AES256); 0 for raw, 6 for AES256 (recommended for modern hardware)

auth.description: Authentication type: 'admin' (default) or 'user'; use 'user' only if admin mode is blocked

seclevel.description: Security level ('none' or 'admin'); leave empty (default) unless legacy device requires explicit setting

timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for each IPMI command — increase if network latency is high

retry.description: Number of retries before failing an IPMI command

hostname.description: Short hostname of the node being fenced (used for naming session files, if enabled)

sid.description: Domain SID for Active Directory integration (advanced; omit in most environments)

ipv6.description: Set to 'yes' to use IPv6; leave empty for IPv4 (default)

port.description: IPMI RMCP UDP port (default: 623); only change if your IPMI firmware uses a nonstandard port
